max.description: The highest value the range admits, inclusive.

min.description: The lowest value the range admits, inclusive.

description:
What a sliced job declares about itself and about what may be adjusted.

An adjustable the manifest does not name takes the envelope's own range; a
manifest range wider than the envelope's is narrowed to the envelope's and
the narrowing is recorded on the print. A manifest may only narrow.

allowed.description: The range each named adjustable may take, inclusive.

file_name.description: The file this manifest is about, as the slicer named it.

material.description: The material the job is sliced for.

nozzle_diameter_mm.description: The nozzle the job is sliced for, in millimetres.

slicer_profile.description: The slicer profile the job was sliced with.
